adjudication.rationale: The migration `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` inserts legacy `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` lines directly via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without running `EmbeddableHost` callbacks. The new runtime check `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses the *referer* as a URI and queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` using only `uri.host` (e.g. `example.com`). If the migrated DB row contains a legacy value like `https://example.com/1234` (which the old `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` explicitly supported via `URI(h).host`), it will not match `example.com` and embedding will start failing with `invalid referer host` after migration. This regression is verifiable from the diff; tests fabricate records through AR (triggering `before_validation` trimming), so they do not cover the migration path.
